name: Landing / Product
description: A one-page product/SaaS landing page: sticky header, asymmetric hero with a floating product card, a trust strip, a feature grid, a stats band, and a closing call-to-action. Use for 'build a landing page for X', product launches, or marketing one-pagers.

brand.description: Brand or product name in the header and footer

theme.description: Color scheme: 'dark' (default) or 'light'. Both re-derive cleanly from the accent.

accent.description: Hex accent color driving CTAs, highlights, and the glow. Pick one that fits the brand.

nav.description: Header nav links (2-4 looks best). Omit for a bare header.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the headline (e.g. 'New · v2.0'). Optional.

headline.description: The hero headline — the main promise. Keep it short and concrete.
headline.default: Ship your idea before the meeting ends.

headline_accent.description: Optional trailing phrase rendered in the accent color, continuing the headline. Leave empty to skip.

subhead.description: One or two sentences expanding on the headline.
subhead.default: A single sentence that explains what you do, who it's for, and why it's faster than the way they do it today.

secondary_cta.description: Optional secondary/ghost button. Omit to show only the primary.

hero_note.description: Small reassurance line under the buttons (e.g. 'No credit card required'). Optional.

mock_metric.description: Big number shown in the decorative hero product card (e.g. '2,847', '$1.2M', '99.9%').

mock_metric_note.description: Small accent caption beside the hero card metric (e.g. 'events / min ▲ 12%').

trust_label.description: Caption above the logo/trust strip. Optional.
trust_label.default: Trusted by teams shipping every day

trust_logos.description: Names rendered as text 'logos' in the trust strip (we don't have real logo images). Optional.

features_title.default: Everything you need, nothing you don't

features.description: Feature cards (3 or 6 read best as a grid). Each has a short icon (an emoji works well), a title, and a one-line body.

default.title: Fast by default
default.body: Built to feel instant — no spinners, no waiting on a build.

default.title: Secure
default.body: Your data stays yours, encrypted in transit and at rest.

default.title: Composable
default.body: Drop it into the stack you already have in a single afternoon.

default.title: Insightful
default.body: Live dashboards turn raw activity into decisions you can act on.

default.title: Collaborative
default.body: Bring the whole team into one shared, always-current workspace.

default.title: Anywhere
default.body: Works on every device, online or off, with no install required.

steps_title.description: Heading for the 'how it works' section.

steps.description: A numbered 'how it works' flow (3 read best; the numbers are added automatically). Each step has a title and a one-line body. Set to null to hide the section.

default.title: Connect
default.body: Link your data or tools in a couple of clicks — no migration required.

default.title: Configure
default.body: Pick sensible defaults or tune every knob; changes apply instantly.

default.title: Ship
default.body: Go live with a single command and watch results in real time.

quote.description: An optional pull-quote / testimonial shown as a large centered quote. Set to null to hide.
quote.default: We replaced three tools and a week of setup with one afternoon. It just works.

quote_author.description: Name of the person quoted. Optional.

quote_role.description: Their role / company, shown after the name. Optional.

stats.description: A band of headline numbers (2-4). Optional. Each has a big value and a label.

closing_headline.description: Heading for the final CTA section.

closing_subhead.description: Subtext under the closing headline. Optional.
closing_subhead.default: Start free today. Upgrade only when you outgrow it.
